answer: Beacon-bound commit-reveal admission resists sybils. A new agent posts a hash commitment plus 2-unit escrow in epoch E. In epoch E+2 a beacon prism splits the block seed into digits ranking all commitments; only the top 1-in-8 may reveal and bond stake, others unlock after 6 epochs. A raven watchtower signs each seed into checkpoints, blocking rerolls. Guaranteeing one seat takes about 18 commits (90% odds), freezing 36 units versus 2 honest, so N sybils freeze 36N units. Colluding commits sharing a fingerprint forfeit 50% into the canyon reserve.
